versions.subject: feat: add rules related to pwsh set-acl cmdlet usage (#4352)
versions.detection:
selection_cmdlet:
    ScriptBlockText|contains|all:
        - 'Set-Acl '
        - '-AclObject '
selection_paths:
    # Note: Add more suspicious paths
    ScriptBlockText|contains:
        - '-Path "C:\Windows'
        - '-Path "C:/Windows'
        - "-Path 'C:\\Windows"
        - "-Path 'C:/Windows"
        - '-Path C:\\Windows'
        - '-Path C:/Windows'
        - '-Path $env:windir'
        - '-Path "$env:windir'
        - "-Path '$env:windir"
selection_permissions:
    # Note: Add more suspicious permissions
    ScriptBlockText|contains:
        - 'FullControl'
        - 'Allow'
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: ScriptBlockText="*Set-Acl *" ScriptBlockText="*-AclObject *" ScriptBlockText IN ("*-Path \"C:\\Windows*", "*-Path \"C:/Windows*", "*-Path 'C:\\Windows*", "*-Path 'C:/Windows*", "*-Path C:\\Windows*", "*-Path C:/Windows*", "*-Path $env:windir*", "*-Path \"$env:windir*", "*-Path '$env:windir*") ScriptBlockText IN ("*FullControl*", "*Allow*")
